_README: Machine-readable Mindscape stat effects, keyed by avatar id then Mindscape level (1-6).
mindscapes.json only holds display text, so the numbers the calculator applies live here.
props        : {PropertyId: raw_value} using the same ids as avatars/equipments
unconditional: true  -> always counted, matches what the in-game stat sheet shows
false -> only counted with --with-conditional (needs a combat trigger)
note         : plain-English reminder of the trigger / why props may be empty
Empty props with a note means the effect is not a flat stat (damage multipliers,
RES ignore, team-wide buffs, stat-scaling conversions) and cannot be expressed here.
